statement: Assuming H(7/8) (no zero of any Dirichlet L-function with Re s > 7/8): every odd composite n >= psi_13 = 3317044064679887385961981 has a prime Miller-Rabin witness p <= (0.529 ln n)^8, and every odd composite n < psi_13 has one among the primes <= 41. Hence testing every prime base p <= max(41, (0.529 ln n)^8) is a deterministic primality test in (log n)^(10+o(1)) bit operations. log10 W(2^1024) = 20.597. Reference point (recorded, not an explicit bound): with the best published theta = 8748867/10000000 (Xu-Sang) the exponent would be 12502266/1251133 = 9.99275536..., but no explicit C has been written out for that theta.
status: First explicit witness bound accepted (PR #8, zero pairing; builds on PR #6)

metric.name: C in W(n) = (C ln n + D)^(1/(1-theta)) at theta = 7/8, D = 0, n0 = psi_13 (priority: exponent, then C, D, n0; checker also reports log10 W(2^1024))

scope: Bit complexity on a multitape Turing machine, Harvey-van der Hoeven multiplication. Conditional on H(theta). For comparison: Lenstra-Pomerance AKS is (log n)^(6+o(1)) unconditionally; under GRH (theta = 1/2) this method gives 4.

assumptions.statement: H(7/8): OpenAI, 'The Quasi-Riemann Hypothesis: A Zero-Free Half-Plane Re(s) > 7/8' (2026-09-30). Not peer reviewed; the statement (not the proof's applications) is formalized in Lean (lean/ComparatorChallenges/DirichletSevenEighths.lean).
theta = 8748867/10000000 (Xu-Sang, arXiv:2610.15291), assuming the analytic inputs of A1. Not peer reviewed.

The preprint's statement covers every modulus q and every Dirichlet character (including imprimitive ones, via Euler factors), uniformly, as docs/template-T1.md requires. Confirmed clause by clause against paper Thm 1.1, the Quadratic transfer proposition and the Lean statement (PR #5; recheck corrections in PR #9).

Lemma T1 (docs/template-T1.md) holds under H(7/8) with the constants in candidates/explicit-t1-zero-pairing-7-8.json (w1 1, alpha 0.5276, beta 0.0232, gamma 4.221, delta 0, y_min 29). Proof: research/zero-pairing/PROOF.md, building on research/first-explicit-t1/PROOF.md; independently rechecked; accepted by the maintainer with PR #8.

Every odd composite n < psi_13 = 3317044064679887385961981 has a strong witness among the first 13 primes (Sorenson-Webster, Math. Comp. 86 (2017) 985-1003). Peer reviewed; sanity-checked by verify/check.py smalln.
